content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 12.4 (p0045) imposed a one-way Customer non-solicit/no-hire covering *all* Vendor employees for the term plus 24 months, expressly excluding any general-advertising or unsolicited-applicant carve-out, and directly contradicting § 12.3's acknowledgement that Customer has made no no-hire commitment. That fails every fallback element and sits in walk-away territory (no-hire, all personnel, 24 months), so I flagged it as a deviation and took the preferred position with a single surgical edit to the prohibitory operator and duration, offering the mutual 12-month involved-personnel fallback in the comment. The separate non-compete paragraph also numbered 12.4 (p0046) belongs to the exclusivity/non-compete rule and was left untouched.
